newsitem.title: USA: Samsung Electronics says will buy stock.
newsitem.headline: Samsung Electronics says will buy stock.

text.p: Samsung Electronics Co Ltd said it began on Monday its previously announced tender offer to buy all outstanding shares of common stock of AST Research Inc for $5.40 each.

The company said its offer is part of the previously announced agreement between itself and AST under which it will buy any remaining AST shares in a cash merger at the same price paid in the tender offer.
The company said its offer was for all the shares not already owned by itself of its affiliates.

The company said it and its affiliates own about 46 percent of the outstanding shares of AST's common stock, and have options that could result in ownership of about 49 percent of the outstanding shares.
The company said the offer and withdrawal rights will expire at 1700 EST/2100 GMT Monday, May 19, unless it choses to extend the offer.
The company said Salomon Brothers Inc is the dealer manager in connection with the offer. MacKenzie Partners Inc is the information manager.
